newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica tariff reform will help correct rand-Erwin.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica tariff reform will help correct rand-Erwin.

text.p: Tariff reforms planned under South Africa's GEAR macro-economic plan will help bring the rand to its correct level, Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin said on Thursday.
"Previous subsidies and tariffs had the effect of overvaluing the rand," Erwin told parliament during debate on trade and tariffs.

"As we remove these tariffs and subsidies, we get closer to the correct value of the rand and I think we have often lost sight of the fact that the adjustments that took place in 1996 in some measure were correct adjustments in line with the real economy," Erwin said.
